description: She wears a cream full-length linen-like dress with a neckline near the collarbones and long sleeves to the wrists. Over it is an open warm ochre-brown robe with gold and dark geometric woven borders along the front, cuffs and hem. A broad matching sash belt wraps her waist, with narrow fringed ties and tassels hanging down the front. The dress has a closed floor-length skirt and opaque fabric. Small gold drop earrings add ornament. Brown soft leather shoes show beneath the hem. Her head is uncovered and she carries no armor or weapons.
